title: 谷歌重磅论文：内部已实现RSI，Opus经验喂给Gemini，AI拥有进化记忆
content: Google researchers introduced the Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) mechanism within their Continual Recursive Self-Improvement (CRSI) framework. SIM records structured logs of previous AI modifications, including rationales and outcomes, allowing new models to inherit optimization experience from different model families. Unlike traditional approaches that lose contextual knowledge when switching models, SIM preserves the "why" behind code changes. Experimental results demonstrate that models equipped with SIM significantly outperform those relying solely on code transfer or cold starts, effectively enabling cumulative, recursive self-improvement in AI agent development.

title: DeepSeek 新一轮千亿级融资落地，梁文锋保留绝对控制权
content: DeepSeek's operating entity recently completed a financing round raising approximately 105.5 billion yuan, valuing the company at roughly 615.5 billion yuan post-investment. This marks the second round of funding, bringing total capital raised in 2026 to over 150 billion yuan. The company added Hangzhou Chengyan as a shareholder, encompassing 31 new partners including Tencent and CATL. Founder Liang Wenfeng retains absolute control with approximately 67.42% ownership, while external investors hold only indirect economic interests through the platform.

title: 记录一次弹门户验证到解除
content: A user’s Claude Pro account, registered in 2023 via Gmail and paid using a Google Play gift card and Chinese Visa, was suspended in November 2026 for violating regional access policies. The suspension followed IP changes, heavy API usage, and a portal verification prompt. The user submitted a KYC appeal with a new passport. After a review, the account was reinstated the same day. The user contrasts this experience with a friend’s similarly configured but unaffected account, noting the free tier remains active.
